title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 145 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 145 - Certificate of Deduction of Tax, etc. (1) Any person who deducts or collects tax under the provisions of this section, shall, by such deduction or collection, issue a certificate relating to such deduction or collection to the person from whom the tax has been deducted or collected, where mentioned- (a) the name and Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN), if any, of the person from whom tax has been deducted or collected; (b) the amount of tax deducted or collected; (c) the section or sections under which tax is deducted or collected; (d) particulars relating to deduction or collection of tax or deposit thereof in favor of Government treasury; and (e) such other matters as may be prescribed. (2) The Board may, by notification in the Official Gazette, prescribe the following matters, namely:- (a) areas for issuing or transmitting certificates of collection or deduction of tax by electronic means, or by machine readable or computer readable means; (b) the manner of issuing or sending said electronic, machine readable or computer readable certificate.
